description: This file contains unit tests for the OrderTotal functionality within the Order aggregate in the ApplicationCore entities of the eShopOnWeb project. It verifies the correct calculation of order totals for different scenarios using the Xunit framework.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the Order's Total method.

methods.name: IsZeroForNewOrder
methods.description: Tests that a new order with no items has a total cost of zero.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven1Item
methods.description: Verifies the total calculation when the order has a single item.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven3Items
methods.description: Checks that the total is correctly calculated when multiple items are present.
